# Spill Prevention & SPCC Training

> Spill Prevention & SPCC Training: 3 self-paced online courses from $29.99. 100% online, certificate on completion, team pricing.

Self-paced online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com), part of Industrial Certified Training, LLC (https://ictraining.us/). Courses are 100% online and work on any device, with a certificate of completion as soon as the final exam is passed. Team pricing applies from 2 to 1,000 seats. Phone: 1-866-429-6742.

## Courses

- [OSHA Spill Prevention and Response Safety Training](https://spill-prevention.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-542): $29.99 per person, 1 hour, English and Spanish, certificate valid 12 months. In accordance with Federal OSHA Hazardous Waste Operations and Emergency Response (HAZWOPER) Standards for the Construction Industry (29 CFR 1926.65) and General Industry (29 CFR 1910.120). Enroll: https://spill-prevention.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=542. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/osha-spill-prevention-and-response-safety-training
- [Cal/OSHA Spill Prevention and Response Safety Training](https://spill-prevention.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-518): $39.99 per person, 1 hour, English and Spanish, certificate valid 12 months. In accordance with Federal OSHA Hazardous Waste Operations and Emergency Response (HAZWOPER) Standards for the Construction Industry (29 CFR 1926.65) and General Industry (29 CFR 1910.120). Enroll: https://spill-prevention.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=518. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/cal-osha-spill-prevention-and-response-safety-training
- [EPA Spill Prevention, Control, and Countermeasure (SPCC) Training](https://spill-prevention.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-558): $42.99 per person, 2 hours, English, certificate valid 12 months. In accordance with the EPA’s SPCC Rule under the Federal Clean Water Act (CWA). Enroll: https://spill-prevention.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=558. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/epa-spill-prevention-control-and-countermeasure-spcc-training
